svg.title: Count. Finance, in your own words. Product concept, in development.
svg.desc: An illustrated voice note lends Kevin US$5,000 from a Bancolombia Pod at 12% interest. Count asks whether the rate is effective annual or monthly. Annual is selected. A bank decrease and an equal receivable are recorded; the twelve-month dial represents time-aware accounting. This is a product concept, not a live app.

g.text: The right Pod. A balanced entry.
